subject: RFI: centralizing compliance tooling — risk-owner mapping & SOW needs
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Moore <claire@trustworks.com>, sales@drata.io, partnerships@vanta.io
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:02:12 -0700
Subject: RFI: centralizing compliance tooling — risk-owner mapping & SOW needs

Hi Claire / Drata / Vanta partnerships team,

We're collecting structured RFIs as part of a potential consolidation of our compliance tooling for NimbusHealth (SOC 2 + HITRUST adjacency). Attached is a short template (redwood_rfi_v1.pdf) and an internal risk-owner matrix we want vendors to help validate.

Top asks:
- Can your product cover automated evidence collection for a hybrid mix of cloud and on-prem services? (specifically AWS + private DB clusters)
- How do you support split ownership for risk controls (IT ops vs platform vs product)? We attached a sample risk_owner_matrix.xlsx — please annotate which controls you can auto-verify and which require manual attestations.
- High-level SOW ballpark for a 3-month pilot + onboarding support (hours & deliverables).
- Any managed services/consulting options to accelerate evidence collection?

Please respond with a single annotated matrix and a short SOW snapshot by EOD Friday (2027-08-13). Monica and Laura are copied and will coordinate the pilot decision.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_rfi_v1.pdf, risk_owner_matrix.xlsx

From: Claire Moore <claire@trustworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:18:45 -0400
Subject: Re: RFI: centralizing compliance tooling — risk-owner mapping & SOW needs

Ben — thanks for the template, and for including the risk matrix. Quick answers up front: we can cover the vast majority of automated evidence for AWS services and many common on-prem patterns via our collector appliance; we do support split control ownership via customizable attestations and role-based workflows.

I'll have an annotated matrix back by Thursday COB and a 3-month pilot SOW snapshot by Friday. A couple quick clarifying Qs for scope planning:
- Which on-prem services are in-scope (DB hostnames / approximate count)?
- Do you require continuous monitoring or weekly attestations during the pilot?

I can run this with our integrations lead — copying their contact (we will include our implementation PM in the next message).

—Claire
Claire Moore
Head of Customer Success, TrustWorks
claire@trustworks.com

--- Original attachment referenced: redwood_rfi_v1.pdf ---

From: Drata Sales <sales@drata.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 13:02:01 -0400
Subject: Re: RFI: centralizing compliance tooling — risk-owner mapping & SOW needs

Hi Ben,

Appreciate the RFI. Drata can auto-collect many cloud evidence types and has partners for on-prem collectors; we typically scope pilots for a 30–60 day technical integration + 4-week SOC readiness window.

We attached a short note (inline below) addressing the matrix columns you highlighted and a sample SOW ballpark (we'll send a clean PDF if you want).

Sample SOW estimate: 45–80 hours for connectors & role mapping, plus optional managed evidence collection at an additional monthly rate.

Questions:
- Are you using an IdP we should integrate with for attestation flows?
- Any regulatory timeline pressures beyond the pilot?

Best,
Drata Sales Team
sales@drata.io

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:27:33 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: centralizing compliance tooling — risk-owner mapping & SOW needs

Ben — internal quick note before vendor deliverables come in.

Context for vendors: NimbusHealth environment has ~12 production DB hosts (mix of RDS and private Postgres), 3 on-prem analytics nodes, and our IdP is Okta. We want continuous automated evidence where possible, but for pilot we're ok with weekly attestations on items that are not fully automatable.

Decision criteria (short):
- Coverage of primary SOC 2 controls (security & change management)
- Effort to onboard (hours + number of infra connectors)
- Ability to map owner groups to our org chart and send targeted attestations
- Price for managed assistance for the first 90 days

I'll draft a one-pager scoring rubric and share it by EOD. Laura, can you confirm budget guardrails for pilot?

Thanks,
Monica
Director, Customer Reliability
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 10:41:02 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: centralizing compliance tooling — risk-owner mapping & SOW needs

Monica — budget note: we have up to $40k (one-time) budgeted for tooling enablement for the pilot phase across the NimbusHealth account, plus $6k/mo run-rate we can reallocate temporarily from professional services. If a vendor requires more than that for basic onboarding I want to see clear ROI / time-to-automation.

Also: ensure any SOW includes an explicit stop-gap rollback plan in case the collector impacts DB performance; we cannot accept a black-box appliance without rollback safeguards.

Laura
VP, Customer Success
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Claire Moore <claire@trustworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 16:44:05 -0400
Subject: Re: RFI: centralizing compliance tooling — risk-owner mapping & SOW needs

Ben / Monica / Laura,

Attached is the annotated risk_owner_matrix.xlsx with our proposed auto-verify flags and a pilot SOW summary. Key highlights:
- We can auto-verify ~72% of the controls you listed for NimbusHealth with our cloud collectors and lightweight on-prem agent.
- Proposed pilot: 8 weeks (2-week discovery, 4-week connector build + role mapping, 2-week verification & closeout).
- SOW estimate: $28k one-time + optional $3k/mo managed evidence package during the pilot.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/rfi/risk-matrix
HubSpot: HS-123456789

We'll schedule a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow if that works — I'm free 10–12 ET.

Best,
